offerings.name: Firecrawl Search (/search)
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results; credits included per plan (Free 1,000/月, Hobby 5,000, Standard 100,000, Growth 500,000, Scale 1,000,000)。Pay-as-you-go: 5 USD = 1,000 credits (Hobby) 至 5,000 credits (Scale)。
offerings.price_basis: Scale PAYG increment ($5 = 5,000 credits → $0.001/credit；搜索每次调用消耗 2 credits/10 results，即千次查询 200 credits)
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits every month, refreshed monthly, no credit card required (约 500 searches)
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果 (titles, descriptions, URLs，可选附 scrapeOptions 抓取每条结果的全文内容)
offerings.note: 1–10 results = 2 credits, 11–20 = 4 credits, 向上取整；scrapeOptions 另计 scrape 费用 (基础 1 credit/页, JSON +4)。企业 ZDR: end-to-end 10 credits/10 results, anonymized 2 credits。支持 web/news/images 及 research/pdf/developer 类别。
